acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p stoa-transit -- dns_auth_cache passes with SPF/DMARC/ARC tests
description:
Implement DnsAuthCache struct (renamed from DkimKeyCache) covering all four evidence types.

File: crates/transit/src/dns_auth_cache.rs

```rust
pub struct DnsAuthCache {
    pool: sqlx::AnyPool,
    ipfs: Arc<dyn IpfsStore>,
    dns_cache: Arc<DnsCache>,
}

impl DnsAuthCache {
    pub fn new(pool: sqlx::AnyPool, ipfs: Arc<dyn IpfsStore>, dns_cache: Arc<DnsCache>) -> Self

    /// Cache all DNS authentication evidence for an article.
    /// Covers DKIM, ARC, SPF, and DMARC. Never returns Err.
    pub async fn cache_from_article(&self, article_bytes: &[u8])
}
```

Algorithm for cache_from_article:
1. DKIM + ARC: call extract_dkim_selectors (which now also handles ARC-Message-Signature)
   For each (selector, domain):
   - Fetch {selector}._domainkey.{domain} TXT
   - Evidence type: 'dkim' for DKIM-Signature, 'arc' for ARC-Message-Signature
   - Parse algorithm (k=), key bytes (p=), handle empty p= as revoked
   - Store raw TXT as CID blob; upsert dns_auth_cache row

2. SPF: call extract_spf_domain
   If Some(domain):
   - Fetch {domain} TXT records, filter for those starting with 'v=spf1'
   - Take the first match (only one SPF record should exist per RFC 7208)
   - Store raw TXT as CID blob; record_status='active', policy=raw_txt
   - evidence_type='spf', selector=''
   - On NODATA: tombstone existing 'active' SPF row if present

3. DMARC: call extract_dmarc_domain
   If Some(domain):
   - Fetch _dmarc.{domain} TXT
   - Parse p= tag from value for the policy field
   - Store raw TXT as CID blob; policy=raw_txt, record_status='active'
   - evidence_type='dmarc', selector=''
   - On NODATA: tombstone existing 'active' DMARC row if present

Shared upsert logic (extract into private fn):
- now_ms = wall clock ms (unwrap_or(1))
- INSERT OR IGNORE (domain, selector, record_cid, first_seen_ms=now_ms, last_seen_ms=now_ms, ttl_secs, evidence_type, algorithm, key_bytes, policy, record_status='active')
- If INSERT ignored (row exists): UPDATE last_seen_ms=now_ms WHERE evidence_type=? AND domain=? AND selector=? AND record_cid=?
- On NODATA for known 'active' row: UPDATE record_status='rotated', last_seen_ms=now_ms

Defensive rules:
- All errors logged, never propagated to caller
- SPF: skip if multiple v=spf1 records (RFC 7208 §3.2 permerror); log warn
- DMARC: skip if TXT value does not start with 'v=DMARC1'; log debug
- No unwrap() in non-test code
title: DnsAuthCache: DNS fetch and store for DKIM, SPF, DMARC, ARC
